title: M3.4: Slack inbound adapter: threads, direct messages and mentions
description:
Normalize message.im, app_mention and thread replies: conversation key team:channel:thread_ts (or ts for a new thread), direct messages to the member's direct channel, bot selection by binding default, mention or leading name, ignoring the app's own messages and bot_id messages (loop prevention), edited and deleted subtypes ignored in v1.

Acceptance criteria:
- A thread reply lands in the same Chatticus channel as its root
- A new top-level mention opens a new external channel
- Messages from the app itself and other bots do not start turns
- A message from an unlinked Slack user is quarantined

Gherkin: features/slack_inbound.feature

Depends on: M3.2, M3.3, M2.1

Contract: the External channels contract (initiative description; draft docs/EXTERNAL_CHANNELS.draft.md).

Process: Gherkin first (AGENTS.md outside-in). Write the named feature, add it to features/cucumber-features.txt, implement steps in conversation/features-support/steps/, then production code. Vitest only for pure helpers. Both cucumber-js and vitest must pass. No emojis, no compatibility forks, tenant_id on every item, strangers get 404. Product PR into develop with sub-agent review.
